findings_to_judge.finding: US Mint American Eagle silver bullion sales in Gold.com's fiscal Q4 (Apr/May/Jun 2026) were 380,500 / 0 / 260,000 coins = 640,500, down 76% from the year-ago quarter's 2,620,000 (1,530,000 / 775,000 / 315,000) and down 92% from Q3 FY26's 8,180,000, with May 2026 the first calendar month of zero bullion Silver Eagle sales in the program's 40-year history - and Gold.com is both a Mint Authorized Purchaser and, since consolidating Sunshine Minting on 2026-04-02, the owner of the Mint's primary silver blank supplier.
findings_to_judge.source_date: 2026 (May-2026 data month; date verified independently - see independence)

findings_to_judge.finding: The retail premium over spot on 1oz American Silver Eagles - which is Gold.com's actual revenue per ounce, not the metal price - peaked at 19.16% on 2026-02-17 inside fiscal Q3, then fell to a 5.30% low on 2026-04-24, 6.69% on 2026-05-25 and a ~7.93% June average across fiscal Q4, and has kept falling in the current quarter: 8.48% average in July 2026 against 6.87% in August 2026.

Third-party e-commerce estimates put jmbullion.com revenue at $66.4M in July 2026 and down 24% over the trailing three months versus the preceding three months, while Similarweb's July 2026 data shows the site's global rank deteriorating from 18,648 to 20,259 over three months and traffic down 3% month-on-month.

The company's own nine-month numbers imply extreme operating leverage that makes the lone $0.96 Q4 estimate fragile: 9M gross profit $342.8M less Q3's $176.6M leaves $166.2M for H1, and 9M net income $70.2M less Q3's $59.5M leaves just $10.7M - so at an H1-like ~$83M quarterly gross profit the business earns roughly $0.19 a quarter, against a Q4 cost base now carrying Q3's $78M SG&A plus a full quarter of consolidated Sunshine Minting and $19M+ of quarterly interest.

Global bar-and-coin gold demand fell 36% sequentially to 307.1t in calendar Q2 2026 from 476.8t in Q1 -- and those are precisely the two quarters that map to Gold.com's fiscal Q4 (the quarter being reported, one estimate at $0.96) and fiscal Q3 (which printed $2.09), while retail premium spreads simultaneously troughed at multi-year lows and US Mint Silver Eagle bullion orders from Authorized Purchasers, of which A-Mark is one, hit exactly zero in May 2026.

The baseline's two-print reaction history is half contaminated: the +9.87% move attributed to the 2026-02-05 amc earnings release was in fact the same-evening 4:10pm ET announcement of a $150m Tether PIPE at $44.50 with a board seat, alongside EPS of only $0.46 -- leaving 2026-05-06 (+0.95% on a sequential EPS jump from $0.46 to $2.09) as the only clean earnings reaction this registrant has produced.

Gold closed fiscal Q4 at $4,007.69 on 30 June 2026 and then rallied above $4,700 by 24 August -- its first move above $4,600 since 15 May -- before giving back 5.62% in the final week of August, and Silver Eagle premiums recovered from the 6.69% May trough to an 8.57% July average; so management reports a dead quarter into a rising, volatile one that resembles the regime that generated fiscal Q3's $2.09.
